package.description: A lightweight soundboard with global hotkeys.

en-US.description: A lightweight soundboard with global hotkeys.
en-US.longDescription:
Honk is a lightweight, cross-platform soundboard. Import your sounds, bind them to global hotkeys, and play them without leaving whatever you're doing.
It can play through two output devices at once, sort pads into categories, and share boards as .honk files. It makes no network requests.
en-US.name: Honk
